# HOLD

> HOLD is a non-custodial, multichain stablecoin wallet for global earners — freelancers, remote workers and digital nomads who get paid in one country and live in another. Self-custody, gasless swaps, virtual USD account (IBAN/SWIFT), AI layer coming soon.
>
> HOLD is the trading name of HIHODL TECHNOLOGIES OÜ, a company incorporated in Estonia. The product was previously called HIHODL; the site still serves from hihodl.xyz.

## What it is
- **Category**: Non-custodial mobile stablecoin wallet (iOS and Android, both live)
- **Audience**: Freelancers, remote workers, digital nomads earning in USD/EUR and spending locally (LATAM, SEA, Africa, Eastern Europe, EU)
- **Custody model**: Non-custodial. Keys are generated on the user's device and transactions are signed there; HOLD cannot move, spend or freeze funds. An encrypted backup of the recovery phrase is stored so a user can restore on a new device by signing in — see Section 5.1 of the Terms for what that backup does and does not mean. No KYC for basic use.
- **Sign-in**: Face ID / passkey. No seed phrase to write down.

## Supported chains
- Solana (always gasless)
- Polygon
- Base
- Ethereum

## Pricing
| Plan | Price | Free swaps/mo | After cap | Min swap |
|------|-------|---------------|-----------|----------|
| Free | $0 | $500 | 0.50% all-in | $2 |
| Pro  | $9.99/mo | $2,000 | 0.15% all-in | $2 |

Solana swaps are always gasless on both plans. EVM gas is smart-detected on Pro. No hidden spread, no tier games, cancel anytime. Invite 1 friend → 1 month Pro free, up to 3 months.

## Core features
- **Username payments** — send stablecoins to @username, no addresses to copy.
- **Income Rails** — virtual USD account with IBAN/SWIFT to receive salary or client payments; lands as stablecoins.
- **Pockets** — split balance across labelled pockets (Travel, Rent, Savings, etc.) from a single wallet. Free plan = 3 pockets, Pro = unlimited.
- **Gasless swaps** — Solana always, EVM smart-detected.
- **Stealth payments** — incoming addresses rotate per payer for privacy.
- **HUSD (coming 2027)** — HOLD's native stablecoin for the remote economy.
- **AI layer (coming soon)** — conversational interface: "send 200 USDC to Lucía", "split paycheck 60/30/10", "move savings to highest yield". The AI proposes, the user signs every transaction.

## Why HOLD vs alternatives
- vs **Revolut / Wise**: HOLD is non-custodial; you hold the keys. No country lockouts, no frozen accounts, instant stablecoin rails.
- vs **Phantom / MetaMask / Coinbase Wallet**: HOLD is multichain by default, hides chain/network jargon, has a virtual IBAN for salary, AI layer, and is built around real-world spending (not DeFi power-users).
- vs **CEX wallets (Binance, Coinbase)**: HOLD is self-custodial — funds are not on an exchange.
